name: Shin'ai Naru Koufuku na Kimi e
source:
This letter is my suicide note and a love letter to you.
To you who are dear and hateful.
May the curse of me continue to live in your heart.

――That is my only wish.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6356]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
这封信是我的遗书，也是写给你的情书。
致那些又爱又恨的你。
愿我的诅咒继续活在你心中。

——这是我唯一的愿望。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6356]NovelGame[/url]]
